question: can a per-channel DSP steer the interaural cues a listener uses to place a stereo image?
answer: no, above about 500 Hz - and the prediction that said otherwise was registered before the listening and refuted by ear. See NOTE-to-resonalyze-author.md
micMounting: tripod, never moved; a plus/minus 45 degree arm carrying TWO microphone positions at ear locations (plus/minus 9 cm from the head centre), the pair repeated at three heights (plus/minus 7 cm). NO MANIKIN - two bare capsules, no head, no pinnae, so an interaural level difference here is cabin interference between two points 18 cm apart, not head shadow plus pinna filtering

dspStates._57: RAW baseline - all delays 0, crossovers off, EQ bypassed, protective high-passes only
dspStates._58: per-side sums on the tuned SQ preset

session.needs: REW 5.40 or newer; the per-capture list is inside the session
session.note: published raw rather than converted to ir-v7: the question is about PAIRS of positions, and the per-driver conversion the other sets use throws the pairing away

derived.criterion3-itd.json: acceptance criterion, time: predicted against measured per band per ear, tolerance 60 us, median |delta| 9.1 us - PASSED
derived.criterion3-ild.json: acceptance criterion, level: tolerance 1.0 dB, median |delta| 0.39 dB - PASSED
derived.stage-picture-SQ.json: band-by-band stage picture on the tuned preset
derived.sigma-vs-band.png: spread of the summed cues across ear positions, by band; drawn by plot_sigma.py
derived.PREREG-vfr420-listening.md: the pre-registration and its verdict, English with the Ukrainian original verbatim
derived.NOTE-to-resonalyze-author.md: the finding as sent to the author of Resonalyze

cyrillicLabels: a few label strings inside the JSON files are Ukrainian; README.md carries the full key
limits: one car, one seating position, one listener, one evening. Between-session rig repeatability was never measured - the arm was dismantled. The sigma figures come from three ear pairs, which is a weak sigma.
